cause: The stale-catalog consumer regression first returned a generic persistence-capability code instead of the required owner-context conflict, showing the stale entry had been filtered before fallback resolution.

impact.before_fix: stale owner was filtered before run-level conflict classification
impact.safety: no evidence facts leaked; failure remained unavailable
impact.required_fix: preserve run-level catalog authority before liveness filtering

lesson: Treat a run-level owner entry as authoritative before liveness or root filtering so stale entries cannot create a compatibility fallback path.
